source_read: all 45 menu pages and all 559 dish pages of the Tebay, Gloucester, Cairn Lodge and Rheged Civica portals (https://tebayservices.mysaffronportal.com/Menus and its three siblings), downloaded afresh (the 45 menu pages are byte-identical to the earlier run); re-run of the script on them reproduced data/source exactly before my fixes
notes: All 318 items (292 published + 26 held back) compared with their dish pages by a separate text parser (kcal, kJ, fat, saturates, carbs, sugars, fibre, protein, salt, contains/may sets): 0 differences; 8 pages also looked at as screenshots. Fixed: 38 dishes print a contains AND a may-contain of the same nut/cereal key (policy 2: generic allergen now published); 14 dishes printing salt '<0.01' although their own ingredient list names salt (cornflakes, sourdough, halloumi, chorizo, mayonnaise...) no longer publish the salt figure. Held back: Strawberry & Pistachio Polenta Cake (no gluten mark, no ingredient list to confirm). Marked ok: gluten-free brownie, butterbean shakshuka, hazelnut syrup, soy salmon pot salt.
